LightningComponentBundle.description: Two-level breadcrumb for CBS Partner Central (module link + current page label).

property.name: headerTitle
property.label: Header title
property.description: Brand title shown beside the CBS logo.

property.name: homeUrl
property.label: Home URL
property.description: Fallback home URL used by the logo link.

property.name: officialSiteUrl
property.label: Official site URL
property.description: External website link shown in the header utility row.

property.name: contactEmail
property.label: Contact email
property.description: Support email shown in the header utility row.

property.name: supportHotline
property.label: Support hotline
property.description: Support hotline shown in the header utility row.

property.name: showQuickActions
property.label: Show utility links
property.description: Displays official website and contact actions in the header.

property.name: moduleLabel
property.label: Module label
property.description: First segment; clickable label for the module home link.

property.name: modulePageName
property.label: Module named page API name
property.description: Experience Named Page API name opened when the module label is clicked.

property.name: moduleUrl
property.label: Module URL fallback
property.description: Optional fallback URL used when module named page API name is not configured.

property.name: currentPageLabel
property.label: Current page label
property.description: Second segment; plain text for the active page (not a link).

property.name: currentPageName
property.label: Current page API name
property.description: Named Page API name for this Experience page (not shown in UI).

property.name: showSubNavigation
property.label: Show sub navigation (unused)
property.description: Unused; kept because existing Experience pages reference this property.

property.label: Nav items JSON (unused)
property.description: Unused; kept because existing Experience pages reference this property.
